product.ta-bitsy-10.summary: The BITSY 10 was the entry-level single-user system with mini floppy disks.
product.ta-bitsy-10.history: The 1982 handbook lists a base configuration at DM 13,850 and software at DM 1,000. Stuttgart holds a 1984 example.
product.ta-bitsy-10.technical.configurat: A second drive could be added. The handbook lists 360 KB per 5-inch mini floppy disk.
product.ta-bitsy-10.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bitsy-10.technical.limitation: Two disk images of the single-user system are preserved. The ROM and startup testing remain pending.
product.ta-bitsy-10.technical.imd_geomet: The two preserved disks help identify the format in use. Each IMD image contains 160 track sides with ten 512 B sectors, totalling 800 KiB of data. The handbook lists 360 KB per mini floppy.
